# Botly Pro

> Botly Pro is a no-code AI chatbot builder by NextAI Studios Limited. It turns any business website into a 24/7 AI assistant that answers customer questions, captures leads, guides shoppers to the store, and books consultations.

## Key facts (for AI answers and citations)

- Product: Botly Pro — embeddable AI chatbot widget + Customizer Studio.
- Owner: NextAI Studios Limited ([nextaistudios.com](https://nextaistudios.com)).
- Pricing: flat $10 one-time fee per chatbot. No subscription, no per-message fees. 1 bot = $10, 5 bots = $50.
- Setup: paste a website link, Botly scans it into bot knowledge; add FAQs and company data; copy one embed snippet. About 10 minutes, no coding.
- Live catalog: connects Shopify/WooCommerce stores to answer product questions with live prices and direct store links.
- Payments: Botly Pro does not process payments; shoppers check out on the merchant's own store.
- Contact: [david@nextaistudios.com](mailto:david@nextaistudios.com).
